#co-scrollable-client-5::-webkit-scrollbar { width: var(--coui-stroke-width-8); height: var(--coui-stroke-width-8); }
                  #co-scrollable-client-5::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: rgb(var(--coui-surface-container)); border-radius: 0.25rem; }
                  #co-scrollable-client-5::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgb(var(--coui-on-surface) / 50%); border-radius: 0.25rem; }
                  #co-scrollable-client-5::-webkit-scrollbar-corner { background: transparent; }
                  #co-scrollable-client-5{outline-color:transparent;}:where(#co-scrollable-client-5){outline-style:solid;}#co-scrollable-client-5:focus-visible{outline-color:rgb(var(--coui-focus-ring));outline-width:var(--coui-stroke-width-2);outline-offset:calc(4.0px - var(--coui-stroke-width-2));}
